title: Why Do People Dance?
overview: In the midst of an era of conflict, Oniyasha wrestles with a question he cannot answer.

title: You Have a Body
overview: Fascinated by the woman's haunting performance, Oniyasha seeks her out and requests to watch her dance again.

title: You Have Your Own Sense of "Good"
overview: The Kanze Troupe has a once-in-a-lifetime chance to perform for the shogun, but it's an opportunity that weighs heavily on Oniyasha's shoulders.

title: Differing Scales of Progress
overview: As the Kanze Troupe takes the stage at Imakumano, Oniyasha gains a new perspective on both his father and the shogun.

title: A Budding Throb
overview: Two rival troupes hold a competition, and the stakes couldn't be higher. The losing troupe must forfeit the shogun's patronage and disband.

title: Connection
overview: Oniyasha gets a second chance, but he'll have to regain his confidence before facing Zojiro again.

title: In Between
overview: Oniyasha and Kogane struggle to accept Toku's fate.

title: To the Other Side of the Bridge
overview: Oniyasha's stunning performance compels Zojiro to concede defeat. Yet the competition continues, and both performers are forced to face their own limitations.

title: Concealed Feelings
overview: Oniyasha and Zojiro have decided to collaborate, but that doesn't mean everyone is happy about it. Meanwhile, Chiharu struggles with feelings of inadequacy.

title: A World Overflowing
overview: Oniyasha and Zojiro take the stage for the final round, but the competition will end in a way no one predicted.

title: The Moon Before It's Full
overview: Years later, the leader of the Hiyoshi Troupe, Inuo, receives a message telling him to come to Sanjobomon.
